body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes `ObjectForm` being stuck in a perpetual loading state when `mode='create'`, which prevented fields from rendering and caused the MSW-based form test to time out.

**Changes:**
- Clear `loading` state in `ObjectForm` when returning early in create mode.
- Prevent certain schema-only props from being spread onto the `<form>` DOM element to reduce React “unknown prop” warnings.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx | Ensures create mode clears `loading` so the form can render. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx | Filters out some schema props from the set spread onto the DOM `<form>` element. |

`SchemaRenderer` passes most schema keys through as React props (see `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` where `...componentProps` is spread), so `props` here can still contain non-DOM fields like `fields`, `layout`, `columns`, `validationMode`, `showActions`, `fieldContainerClass`, `onCancel`, etc. Because `{...formProps}` is spread onto the `<form>`, these will still produce "React does not recognize the ... prop" warnings. Consider spreading only `schema.props` (or a whitelist of valid `<form>` attributes) and/or explicitly omitting the remaining schema-only keys from `props` before computing `formProps`.
```suggestion
        inputType: _inputType,
        // Additional schema-only props that may be present via SchemaRenderer and must not reach the <form> DOM element
        fields: _fields,
        layout: _layout,
        columns: _columns,
        validationMode: _validationMode,
        showActions: _showActions,
        fieldContainerClass: _fieldContainerClass,
        onCancel: _schemaOnCancel,
```
